changeSet.author: Pappas/Gupta
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetDataProfile') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [Success] bit NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ProfileSetDate] DATETIME NOT NULL, [ProfileIdentifier] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [SampleCount] BIGINT NULL, [NullCount] BIGINT NULL, [BlankCount] BIGINT NULL, [MeanValue] FLOAT NULL, [MinimumValue] NVARCHAR(500) NULL, [MaximumValue] NVARCHAR(500) NULL, [MinimumLength] INT NULL, [MaximumLength] INT NULL, [StandardDeviation] FLOAT NULL, [Multiline] BIT NULL, [RegExp] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, [Confidence] DECIMAL(28,4) NULL, [TypeQualifier] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Type] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [LogicalType] BIT NULL, [LeadingWhiteSpace] BIT NULL, [LeadingZeroCount] INT NULL, [TrailingWhiteSpace] BIT NULL, [MatchCount] BIGINT NULL, [OutlierCardinality] INT NULL, [DataSignature] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [StructureSignature] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Cardinality] INT NULL, [ShapeCardinality] INT NULL, [TotalCount] BIGINT NULL, [OutlierCount] BIGINT NULL, [KeyConfidence] DECIMAL(5,4) NULL, [DetectionLocale] NVARCHAR(64) NULL, [FtaVersion] NVARCHAR(32) NULL, [DecimalSeparator] NCHAR(1) NULL, [UniqueCount] BIGINT NULL, [PopularityCount] BIGINT NULL, [IsAuthorizedForPopularity] BIT NULL, [SourceLastModified] DATETIME NULL, [FilterCount] BIGINT NULL, [Freshness] INT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ExecutionAssetDataProfile] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'FilterCount' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile] ADD [FilterCount] BIGINT NULL END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'Freshness' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile] ADD [Freshness] INT NULL END
